primary.source_window: Common Crawl snapshots summer 2013 through April 2024
primary.additional_terms: Common Crawl Terms of Use apply
primary.rights_caveat: Dataset packaging/license metadata does not establish ownership or blanket relicensing of every underlying source-page text. P50 records this as a public-web research reservoir, not a universal rights-clearance claim.
chosen_because: official Korean Hangul subset is large enough to support fixed-token sampling without mixing P47/P49 private assets
global per-language deduplication reduces repeated-web amplification
upstream exposes stable document metadata needed for contamination and provenance audits
modern web snapshot coverage fits P50 modern-Korean proposer construction better than the historical OKHC world-contact corpus

independent_secondary.rights_caveat: HPLT explicitly states that it does not own the source text. This is not treated as blanket source-text rights clearance.
independent_secondary.reason: Keeping HPLT outside the primary training reservoir preserves an independently processed Common-Crawl-derived comparator.

not_primary.reason: Large Korean corpus but older/redundant Common-Crawl aggregation; no clear scientific gain over FineWeb2 for the primary P50 lane.
Existing KSGT private-data firewall remains binding.
Already owns historical world-contact/representation authority; training reuse would contaminate that role.
Existing semantic-risk/human-anchor/holdout authority; not automatic training supervision.

primary_training_slice_rules.source_split: FineWeb2 kor_Hang train only; upstream test split excluded
primary_training_slice_rules.snapshot_policy: Do not assume crawl date equals content date. Preserve crawl metadata and report snapshot distribution.
primary_training_slice_rules.exact_contamination_exclusion: Before training, hash-normalized exact-match scan against every frozen P50 PIA/evaluation source surface.
primary_training_slice_rules.near_duplicate_exclusion: Before training, MinHash/character-ngram near-duplicate screening against every frozen P50 PIA/evaluation source surface.
primary_training_slice_rules.evaluation_first_rule: P50 PIA source IDs/surfaces must be frozen before final training slice is sealed.
primary_training_slice_rules.text_commit_policy: No sampled raw corpus text committed to GitHub. Only manifests, hashes, statistics, and code are committed.

authority.reason_model_training_hold: PIA source freeze, contamination exclusions, exact corpus manifest, tokenizer receipt, and training-token budget remain to be sealed.
